asset.name: EmptyState
asset.description: The contextual no-results composition explaining why nothing is shown, distinguishing an empty collection from a filtered-out one, and offering the most relevant next action.

requires.reason: Copy uses the shared text styles rather than local typography.
Layout uses the shared spacing ramp.
Actions are shared buttons so affordances look and behave the same everywhere.
The illustrative glyph resolves through the registry.
All class composition uses the shared Tailwind conflict resolver.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Already implemented in the catalog at 1.1.0. The distinction it must carry is no-results versus never-created, because the useful next action is completely different in each case.
